RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel raises valid concerns about unconscious bias, and many civil service bodies violate internal diversity policies when convening single-gender panels. However, composition alone does not prove discrimination; both candidates possess relevant advanced qualifications, and the successful candidate had international leadership experience.

Before formally raising bias, follow up on your requested debrief. Inquire about the competency scoring, how qualifications were weighted against the job description, and your department’s panel-diversity rules. If the feedback reveals arbitrary scoring, lack of objective criteria, or a breach of panel rules, you will have substantive procedural grounds to raise the issue through official civil service grievance channels.
